Q: Why is my python code giving me an error when there is more then one of the same file type? A:

I saw that :

NotADirectoryError: [Errno 20] Not a directory: '/home/mis1nput/Downloads/image000000.jpg/bagels12.jpg' -> '/home/mis1nput/Pictures/bagels12.jpg'

Which means the compiler think you try to copy a .jpg in a jpg (which is not possible).

Then the :

shutil.move(source_folder,destination_folder)

Should be in the loop, for each file

Which means you must have :

        source_file =  os.path.join(source_folder, filename)
        shutil.move(source_file, destination_folder)

in your loop and your condition instead of

        source_folder = os.path.join(source_folder, filename)
        destination_folder = os.path.join(destination_folder, filename)           


shutil.move(source_folder,destination_folder)

I tried it myself and it seems to work, let me know if it worked out for yourself
